name: my-health-site
description: Patient health portal with header banner, upcoming appointments sidebar, and tabbed health summary with category cards

HeadingField.notes: H1 greeting, H2 Upcoming Appointments, H2 My Health, H3 per appointment card (x3)

RichTextDisplayField.notes: Gender/age line in header, provider/address details in appointment cards, secondary text in health cards

CardLayout.notes: 1 header card (dark bg), 3 appointment cards, 7 health summary category cards

ButtonWidget.notes: Request Appointment (SOLID, LARGE) and View All Appointments

ButtonArrayLayout.notes: Wraps Request Appointment button and/or View All Appointments

TabsField.notes: Health Summary, Care Summaries, Vitals, Health Records, Tobacco History, Forms & Documents

Icon.notes: Category icons in health summary cards (Lucide equivalents of SAIL icons) plus chevron-right per card

layout.headerDescription: Dark (#0E3842) card with avatar, greeting heading, gender/age, and Request Appointment button
layout.sidebarDescription: Left narrow pane with Upcoming Appointments heading and 3 appointment cards, plus View All Appointments link
layout.tabsDescription: 6-tab layout in main content area; only Health Summary tab has content
layout.cardGroupDescription: 7 health category cards in 2-column layout with decorative left border, icon, label, secondary text, and chevron

sailMappings.a!headerContentLayout: Page layout with dark header section above two-column content
sailMappings.a!sideBySideLayout: Flexbox row (div with flex items-center gap-*)
sailMappings.a!cardGroupLayout: Grid of CardLayout components (2-column card grid)
sailMappings.a!cardLayout (health category): CardLayout with decorativeBarPosition=START, teal left border
